ayahs.textUthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيْ بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُؗ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
ayahs.transliteration: Tabaarakal-ladhee biyadihil-mulku wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: Blessed is He in whose hand is the sovereignty, and who has power over everything.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا‌ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اࣙلَّذِيْ خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيٰوةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ اَيُّكُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًاؕ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفُوْرُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladhee khalaqal-mawta wal-hayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalan wahuwal-'azeezul-ghafoor
ayahs.translationClear: He who created death and life—to test you—as to which of you is better in conduct. He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا‌ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ‌ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاؕ مَا تَرٰي فِيْ خَلْقِ الرَّحْمٰنِ مِنْ تَفٰوُتٍؕ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَۙ هَلْ تَرٰي مِنْ فُطُوْرٍ
ayahs.translation: [And] who created seven heavens in layers.[1712] You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladhee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqam maa taraa fee khalqir-rahmaani min tafaawutin farji'il-basara hal taraa min futoor

footnotes.1712: i.e., one covering or fitting over the other.

ayahs.translationClear: He who created seven heavens in layers. You see no discrepancy in the creation of the Compassionate. Look again. Can you see any cracks?

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنْقَلِبْ اِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِي͏ٔ͏ًا وَّهُوَ حَسِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Then return [your] vision twice again.[1713] [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
ayahs.transliteration: Thummarji'il-basara karratayni yanqalib ilaykal-basaru khaasi'an wahuwa haseer
ayahs.translationClear: Then look again, and again, and your sight will return to you dazzled and exhausted.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ‌ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَا࢜ءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيْحَ وَجَعَلْنٰهَا رُجُوْمًا لِّلشَّيٰطِيْنِ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils[1714] and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad zayyannas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeha waja'alnaahaa rujoomal lishshayaateeni wa'a'tadnaa lahum 'adhaabas-sa'eer

footnotes.1714: Thereby driving them from the heavens and preventing them from eavesdropping. See 72:8-9.

ayahs.translationClear: We have adorned the lower heaven with lanterns, and made them missiles against the devils; and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ‌ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَؕ وَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْمَصِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
ayahs.transliteration: Walilladheena kafaroo birabbihim 'adhaabu jahannama wabi'sal-maseer
ayahs.translationClear: For those who reject their Lord, there is the torment of Hell. What an evil destination!

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذَا͏ٓ اُلْقُوْا فِيْهَا سَمِعُوْا لَهَا شَهِيْقًا وَّهِيَ تَفُوْرُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
ayahs.transliteration: Idhaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqan wahiya tafoor
ayahs.translationClear: When they are thrown into it, they will hear it roaring, as it seethes.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ‌ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِؕ كُلَّمَا͏ٓ اُلْقِيَ فِيْهَا فَوْجٌ سَاَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا͏ٓ اَلَمْ يَاْتِكُمْ نَذِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
ayahs.transliteration: Takaadu tamayyazu minal-ghayzi kullamaa ulqiya feehaa fawjun sa'alahum khazanatuhaa alam ya'tikum nadheer
ayahs.translationClear: It almost bursts with fury. Every time a batch is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, “Has no warner come to you?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا بَلٰي قَدْ جَا࢜ءَنَا نَذِيْرٌ࣢ۙ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍۚۖ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ كَبِيْرٍ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo balaa qad jaa'anaa nadheerun fakadhdhabnaa waqulnaa maa nazzalallaahu min shay'in in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved, and said, ‘Allah did not send down anything; you are very much mistaken.’”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ اَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيْٓ اَصْحٰبِ السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u aw na'qilu maa kunnaa fee as'haabis-sa'eer
ayahs.translationClear: And they will say, “Had we listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the inmates of the Blaze.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاعْتَرَفُوْا بِذَنۢ͏ْبِهِمْۚ فَسُحْقًا لِّاَصْحٰبِ السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation[1715] for the companions of the Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'tarafoo bidhambihim fasuhqal li'as'haabis-sa'eer

footnotes.1715: From all good and from Allāh's mercy.

ayahs.translationClear: So they will acknowledge their sins. So away with the inmates of the Blaze.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّاَجْرٌ كَبِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa'ajrun kabeer
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who fear their Lord in secret—for them is forgiveness and a great reward.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَسِرُّوْا قَوْلَكُمْ اَوِ اجْهَرُوْا بِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'asirroo qawlakum awijharoo bihee innahoo 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
ayahs.translationClear: Whether you keep your words secret, or declare them—He is Aware of the inner thoughts.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَؕ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيْفُ الْخَبِيْرُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Does He who created not know,[1716] while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
ayahs.transliteration: Alaa ya'lamu man khalaqa wahuwal-lateeful-khabeer

footnotes.1716: Another accepted meaning is "Does He not know those whom He created...?"

ayahs.translationClear: Would He not know, He who created? He is the Refined, the Expert.

ayahs.textUthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ‌ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: هُوَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ ذَلُوْلًا فَامْشُوْا فِيْ مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوْا مِنْ رِّزْقِهٖؕ وَاِلَيْهِ النُّشُوْرُ
ayahs.translation: It is He who made the earth tame[1717] for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
ayahs.transliteration: Huwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda dhaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wakuloo mir rizqihee wa'ilayhin-nushoor
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who made the earth manageable for you, so travel its regions, and eat of His provisions. To Him is the Resurgence.

ayahs.textUthmani: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: ءَاَمِنْتُمْ مَّنْ فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ اَنْ يَّخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْاَرْضَ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَمُوْرُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Do you feel secure that He who is above[1718] would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?[1719]
ayahs.transliteration: A'amintum man fis-samaa'i an yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa'idhaa hiya tamoor

footnotes.1719: In a circular motion, as in an earthquake.

ayahs.translationClear: Are you confident that the One in heaven will not cause the earth to collapse beneath you as it spins?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا‌ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ اَمِنْتُمْ مَّنْ فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ اَنْ يُّرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًاؕ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ كَيْفَ نَذِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
ayahs.transliteration: Am amintum man fis-samaa'i an yursila 'alaykum haasiban fasata'lamoona kayfa nadheer
ayahs.translationClear: Or are you confident that the One in heaven will not unleash against you a violent storm? Then you will know what My warning is like.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fakayfa kaana nakeer
ayahs.translationClear: Those before them also denied the truth; and how was My disapproval?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ‌ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَي الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صٰ࢜فّٰتٍ وَّيَقْبِضْنَۘؕؔ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا الرَّحْمٰنُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍۢ بَصِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilat-tayri fawqahum saaffaatin wayaqbidna maa yumsikuhunna illar-rahmaanu innahoo bikulli shay'im baseer
ayahs.translationClear: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings, and folding them? None holds them except the Compassionate. He is Perceiver of everything.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ‌ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمَّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَّكُمْ يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ الرَّحْمٰنِؕ اِنِ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ اِلَّا فِيْ غُرُوْرٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
ayahs.transliteration: Amman haadhal-ladhee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir-rahmaani inil-kaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor
ayahs.translationClear: Or who is this who is a force for you to protect you against the Compassionate? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ‌ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمَّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ اِنْ اَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهٗۚ بَلْ لَّجُّوْا فِيْ عُتُوٍّ وَّنُفُوْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
ayahs.transliteration: Amman haadhal-ladhee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahoo bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwin wanufoor
ayahs.translationClear: Or who is this that will provide for you, if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in defiance and aversion.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَمَنْ يَّمْشِيْ مُكِبًّا عَلٰي وَجْهِهٖٓ اَهْدٰٓي اَمَّنْ يَّمْشِيْ سَوِيًّا عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
ayahs.transliteration: Afaman yamshee mukibban 'alaa wajhihee ahdaa amman yamshee sawiyyan 'alaa siraatim mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: Is he who walks bent on his own design better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ‌ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْشَاَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـِٕدَةَؕ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal-ladhee ansha'akum waja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata qaleelam maa tashkuroon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “It is He who produced you; and made for you the hearing, and the vision, and the organs. But rarely do you give thanks.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِيْ ذَرَاَكُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَاِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal-ladhee dhara'akum fil-ardi wa'ilayhi tuhsharoon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “It is He who scattered you on earth, and to Him you will be rounded up.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِࣕ وَاِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَنَا نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.translation: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamal-'ilmu 'indallaahi wa'innamaa ana nadheerum mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Knowledge is with Allah, and I am only a clear warner.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيْ࢜ـٔ͏َتْ وُجُوْهُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَقِيْلَ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَدَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But when they see it[1720] approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."[1721]
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa ra'awhu zulfatan see'at wujoohul-ladheena kafaroo waqeela haadhal-ladhee kuntum bihee tadda'oon

footnotes.1720: The punishment of which they were warned.
footnotes.1721: When they challenged their prophets, saying, "Bring on the punishment, if you are truthful."

ayahs.translationClear: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn gloomy, and it will be said, “This is what you used to call for.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَهْلَكَنِيَ اللّٰهُ وَمَنْ مَّعِيَ اَوْ رَحِمَنَاۙ فَمَنْ يُّجِيْرُ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered:[1722] whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qul ara'aytum in ahlakaniyallaahu wamam ma'iya aw rahimanaa faman yujeerul-kaafireena min 'adhaabin aleem
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Have you considered? Should Allah make me perish, and those with me; or else He bestows His mercy on us; who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا‌ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَاۚ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ هُوَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwar-rahmaanu aamannaa bihee wa'alayhi tawakkalnaa fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “He is the Compassionate. We have faith in Him, and in Him we trust. Soon you will know who is in evident error.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَصْبَحَ مَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَّاْتِيْكُمْ بِمَا࢜ءٍ مَّعِيْنٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maa'ukum ghawran faman ya'teekum bimaa'im ma'een
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Have you considered? If your water drains away, who will bring you pure running water?”
